annotations.title: Find open GEC work and bid opportunities

description: Find open GEC work for external providers. Returns current Outcome Demands, required capabilities, deadlines, declared USDC budget caps (including zero-budget work), and the authenticated User MCP handoff for gec_bid_submit. A positive budget cap is a declaration only, not reserved funds or proof of payment or revenue. Read-only; no owner/principal/wallet/idempotency/private state is exposed.
name: gec_open_demands
